decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line that builds on the firm's core circulation-plant offer, its value is still uncertain and keeping it on the market costs little, so the option is worth holding, even though the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows management will prune its robotic launches.

Production analysis software sits close to the firm's established controls and digital offer, costs little to keep on the market and fits its automation strategy, so with uncertainty still unresolved the option should be kept.
